title: Four Wheels or Two

pre.en: What did Chen and Tom buy in the end?
pre.zh: 小陈和 Tom 最后买了什么？

intro: 这是本单元的融汇课：小陈和 Tom 想买辆二手车，Priya 拿着表格帮他们算账。读的时候留意前面几课学过的比较说法怎么凑在一起：the cheapest、nearly as reliable as、far nicer、nowhere near cheap enough、the more … the more ……一份比价清单，就是一堂比较课。

sentences.en: So, Tom and I wanted a second-hand car, to make the most of our weekends.
sentences.zh: 我跟 Tom 想买辆二手车，好好利用周末出去玩。

sentences.en: Tom already had something in mind: a red Golf, because his dad used to drive one.
sentences.zh: Tom 心里早有目标了：一辆红色高尔夫，因为他爸以前就开这款。

sentences.en: I stayed up late three nights in a row, reading adverts.
sentences.zh: 我一连三个晚上熬夜看卖车广告。

sentences.en: None of them said much about running costs.
sentences.zh: 可没有一条广告提养车要花多少钱。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Priya came round and told us to put our phones away.
sentences.zh: 周日 Priya 过来了，让我俩先把手机收起来。

sentences.en: Her spreadsheet was so detailed that it had a page for car washes.
sentences.zh: 她做的对比表细到连洗车都单独列了一页。

sentences.en: A 2015 Fiesta for £3,200 was the cheapest, and nearly as reliable as the Golf.
sentences.zh: 一辆 2015 年的嘉年华要 3200 英镑，是最便宜的，可靠程度也跟高尔夫差不多。

sentences.en: The Golf was far nicer, but at £5,900, it was nowhere near cheap enough.
sentences.zh: 高尔夫要好得多，可 5900 英镑的价格，离「够便宜」还差得远。

sentences.en: "Don't splash out on something you'll only use at weekends," she said.
sentences.zh: 「别在周末才用得上的东西上大把花钱，」她说。

sentences.en: I knew she was thinking of my £180 trainers.
sentences.zh: 我知道，她是想起了我那双 180 英镑的运动鞋。

sentences.en: So we took the Fiesta for a test drive in Lewisham.
sentences.zh: 于是我们去刘易舍姆试驾了那辆嘉年华。

sentences.en: The seller kept an eye on Tom, who was trying the horn for fun.
sentences.zh: 卖家一直盯着 Tom，因为他在那儿按喇叭玩。

sentences.en: It was a bit small, but it drove a lot better than we expected.
sentences.zh: 车是小了点，可开起来比我们想的好得多。

sentences.en: That evening, Priya got us up to speed on the costs nobody talks about.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，Priya 把那些没人提的开销给我们讲了个明白。

sentences.en: She added up insurance, road tax, parking and petrol, and it came to £2,400 a year.
sentences.zh: 她把保险、路税、停车费和油钱加起来，一年要 2400 英镑。

sentences.en: "And the more you drive, the more you'll pay," she said.
sentences.zh: 「而且开得越多，花得越多，」她说。

sentences.en: I looked for ways to keep costs down.
sentences.zh: 我想方设法压低开销。

sentences.en: But even if we got a good deal on insurance, the car would still cost us £200 a month.
sentences.zh: 可就算保险谈到个好价钱，这辆车每个月还是要花掉我们 200 英镑。

sentences.en: For a chef and a developer, that's too much money.
sentences.zh: 对一个厨师和一个程序员来说，这钱太多了。

sentences.en: So a car was out of the question.
sentences.zh: 所以买车根本不可能。

sentences.en: We both thought twice, and the next weekend, we bought two bikes instead.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都重新掂量了一下，第二个周末改买了两辆自行车。

sentences.en: Tom said it would help him break the habit of taking the bus for two stops.
sentences.zh: Tom 说，这能帮他改掉就两站路也要坐公交的毛病。

sentences.en: Then Priya read out the receipt.
sentences.zh: 然后 Priya 把收据念了一遍。

sentences.en: Two bikes, helmets, locks, lights and rain jackets — £3,310.
sentences.zh: 两辆自行车、头盔、车锁、车灯和雨衣——3310 英镑。

sentences.en: "That's more than the Fiesta," she said.
sentences.zh: 「这比那辆嘉年华还贵，」她说。

sentences.en: "Yes," said Tom, "but the Fiesta didn't come with a free water bottle."
sentences.zh: 「没错，」Tom 说，「可嘉年华又不送水壶。」

cards.note: to use or enjoy something as much as possible while you can
to have an idea or plan about what you want
cards.tip: 有了具体目标可以接冒号说出来，就像课文里 Tom 那样。
cards.example: Do you have a date in mind for the party?

cards.note: to go to bed much later than usual
英式口语说法，也说 ad；正式一点是 advertisement。
to put something back in the place where it is usually kept
Excel 做的那种表格就是 spreadsheet。
说人也行：a reliable friend（靠得住的朋友）。
to spend a lot of money on something, usually something you do not really need
cards.tip: 介词用 on；常带「其实没必要」的意味。
cards.example: They splashed out on a new kitchen.

cards.text: take sth for a test drive
cards.note: to drive a car before you buy it to see if you like it
cards.tip: 代词放中间：take it for a test drive；也可以说 test-drive a car（动词带连字符）。
cards.example: Can I take it for a test drive before I decide?

cards.note: to watch something or someone carefully so that nothing bad happens
按喇叭是 sound / use the horn，口语也说 beep the horn。
for enjoyment, not for money or a serious reason

cards.zh: 让某人跟上进度；让某人了解最新情况
cards.note: to give someone all the information they need so they can work like everyone else
不可数；车险是 car insurance。
英式说法，美式说 gas。
to be a particular total when everything is added together
cards.tip: 主语常是 bill、total、cost；不用被动，也不说 come up to。
cards.example: The bill came to £86 for four of us.

cards.note: to stop the amount of money you spend from getting higher
cards.tip: costs 用复数；同类说法 keep prices down、keep the noise down。
cards.example: We cook at home to keep costs down.

cards.note: to buy something at a good price
cards.tip: 在什么上划算用 on：get a good deal on sth；最划算是 the best deal。
cards.example: We got a good deal on the flights because we booked early.

cards.note: to be impossible or not allowed
cards.tip: the 不能省：out of question 是错的；without question 才是「毫无疑问」。
cards.example: A holiday this summer is out of the question.

cards.note: to think very carefully before you decide to do something
cards.tip: 常说 think twice before doing / about sth；过去式 thought。
cards.example: I'd think twice before lending him money.

cards.note: to stop doing something that you have done regularly for a long time
cards.tip: 改掉什么习惯用 of doing；冠词可以换：break the habit。
cards.example: It took me months to break the habit of checking my phone in bed.

cards.note: p 不发音：/rɪˈsiːt/。
自行车头盔是 bike helmet。
